screen.result: All five failed construction. No screened incumbent; not proof of geometric infeasibility.

diagnostic_improvement.finding: Search fallback events and the aggregate failure fallback events were exactly identical, including order; every one was printed twice.
diagnostic_improvement.change: Retain every search_fallback event once. Print an explicit aggregate alias only after exact event-vector and operation-counter equality. Mismatches, unavailable receipts and nonsearch failures retain full output.
diagnostic_improvement.smoke: 80x80 deliberately infeasible carrier: failure captured, 234 events referenced, exit 1 expected. This is a diagnostic failure-path test, not an optimisation candidate.
diagnostic_improvement.disk: Original 54 MiB log losslessly compressed to approximately 2.5 MiB; decompressed SHA-256 verified identical.

tests.scoped_inputs_and_failure_receipts: 2/2 PASS, 36.36 seconds. Invalid modes, unknown scoped sheets and mixed all/scoped requests rejected before any model checkpoint with captured empty-work receipt.
tests.receipt_alias_inputs: PASS, 28.98 seconds. Exact match accepted; event-order mismatch, counter mismatch, uncaptured/unavailable/missing receipts rejected.

limitations: No board improvement, no new full qualification and no controlled timing speedup claim. Valid-request solver behaviour is unchanged by preflight checks and diagnostic aliasing. No published board changed.
next: The scoped decomposition trials did not remove coupled power-facing/legalization conflicts. Investigate the actual constraints and search proposals; do not simply enlarge budgets or waive authored requirements.
